environment.description: Spring Boot application deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB configured in HTTP mode (no TLS termination at ALB). Ingress controller is nginx-ingress with default configuration. The X-Client-Cert-DN header is expected to be set by upstream infrastructure but no mTLS is actually configured on the ALB or ingress. Any authenticated user (basic auth via Cognito) can reach the API endpoints directly. No tenant isolation is enforced at any layer.
